title: DGFT Export Policy Schedule 2 Chapter 73 Heading 7323
text: Export Policy for Heading 7323 (Table, kitchen or other household articles and parts thereof, of iron or steel; iron or steel wool; pot scourers and scouring or polishing pads, gloves and the like, of iron or steel): Status: Free. Subheadings 7323 10 00, 7323 91 10, 7323 93 10 (Pressure cookers), 7323 93 90 (Other stainless steel household articles) are freely exportable without restriction.

title: DGFT Export Policy Schedule 2 Chapter 73 Heading 7326
text: Export Policy for Heading 7326 (Other articles of iron or steel): Status: Free. Export is permitted without any restriction or export licence.

title: DGFT Export Policy Schedule 2 Chapter 96 Heading 9608
text: Export Policy for Heading 9608 (Ball point pens and markers): Status: Free. Export is freely permitted.

title: DGFT Export Policy Schedule 2 Chapter 96 Heading 9617
text: Export Policy for Heading 9617 (Vacuum flasks and other vacuum vessels complete with cases; parts thereof other than glass inners): Status: Free. Export is freely permitted without any restriction or export licence requirements. ITC-HS codes 9617 00 11 (Vacuum flasks having a capacity not exceeding 0.75 l), 9617 00 12 (exceeding 0.75 l), 9617 00 13 (Casserol and other vacuum containers), and 9617 00 90 (Parts) are all Free.

title: DGFT Export Policy Schedule 2 Chapter 96 Heading 9620
text: Export Policy for Heading 9620 (Monopods, bipods, tripods and similar articles): Status: Free. Export is permitted freely.
